verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside Pinecone to which a user can delegate tasks such as managing indexes or data. Pinecone Assistant is a feature for building Q&A assistants over your own data, which is a building block rather than an in-product task delegate. The MCP server and Claude plugin let external agents operate Pinecone, but that is outside the product, not a built-in assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
